themes.title: Geopolitical Debates Over Ukraine and Russia Policy
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures across the US and Europe remain actively engaged in debates over foreign assistance, sanctions policy, and strategic priorities regarding the Russia-Ukraine war. While Donald Trump waives US sanctions on Moscow to incentivize peace talks and lower fuel costs, Scandinavian right-wing leaders like Norway's Sylvi Listhaug explicitly reaffirm support for Ukraine and NATO.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump waives newly passed Russia sanctions and criticizes President Zelenskyy, arguing for direct negotiations and lower energy prices.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP leader Sylvi Listhaug explicitly reaffirms strong support for Ukraine and NATO alongside domestic party platforms.

themes.title: Rising Fuel Costs and Energy Inflation
themes.blurb: Soaring fuel prices and energy inflation serve as central political rallying points for right-wing movements in North America and Scandinavia. Politicians and activists are leveraging voter frustration over gas price surges and tax policies to fault incumbent governments and mobilize base supporters.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: JD Vance and campaign surrogates emphasize high gas prices and energy costs to attack current economic policies at town halls and rallies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP pushes back against fuel tax reinstatements following a 27.7% single-month surge in domestic fuel costs.

themes.title: Anti-Immigration Targeting of Minorities
themes.blurb: Nationalist and right-wing populist parties continue to frame strict border controls and immigration limits as fundamental to protecting national culture and social cohesion. Leaders emphasize the need to confront non-integrated cultural norms and secure borders ahead of upcoming election cycles.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Sylvi Listhaug argues that strict immigration limits protect society from clan culture and religious dominance.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: JD Vance and Trump surrogates place immigration restrictions and border security at the forefront of national campaign events.
